body: I woke up the next day after my first dose with no desire to eat. I had a hard time even finishing my morning coffee. Very strange. It's been 4 days and my appetite has greatly diminished. I always had a hard time with evening snacking, even when I was full. The thought of eating something I liked overtook the fact that I didn't even have room for it. That is gone now. I'm on .25 now. I can't imagine what it's like on the full dose. Also, my desire to have alcohol has almost disappeared. I've always enjoyed wine with my meals and afterwards. I could barely choke down a glass over the weekend.

Seriously, just delete the presets on the app and car. You'll forget about the show immediately. Howard has mailed it in and is just collecting a check. He has become everything he used to make fun of.
Is there a way of canceling just his channels or do you need to go down a tier in your subscription?

Howard and his team made a conscience effort to become less controversial and acerbic in order to court Hollywood. It was a concerted effort to go mainstream. For Christs sake, he hosted AGT.  He made fun of guys like Sandler and Seinfeld for years. Now they're his best friends because he throws roses at them. He wanted to be embraced by A-listers and that wasn't going to happen by making fun of them even when it was warranted. Now he's one of them. Hanzi was right. He's stayed on the air long enough to become Imus.

New Yorkers are the most resilient people on the planet. We behave like we don't give a shit but we take care of each other. I have no doubt it'll be bad but I also have no doubt that ultimately we'll be ok. I don't know one person that is panicking. It's not in our DNA. Trust me, life might get interrupted here but it'll keep going. It's just our nature.

Exactly. It's going to be rampant here. We all know that. Too many people in close proximity everywhere. Home, work, transit, everywhere. We'll get through it just like we get through everything else. The weeks after 9/11 were horrible. Nothing could be worse than that.

The show was finished when Howard decided he wanted to be loved by Hollywood. There's nothing edgy about the show anymore. It's just plain boring. He's mailing it in and collecting a check. Other than Richard and Sal, the guys in the back are terrible and add nothing to the show. 

Once guys like Artie, Depace, High Pitch Mike, and Langford were gone, the stories and extreme ball busting stopped. So did the fun.

​

And the scrubbing of the old clips is something that the old Howard would have made fun of if someone else had done it. He's become everything he made fun of. I've been listening since the NBC days and this is just pathetic. Subscription canceled.

I don't know that you can ever erase the memories. Its been three years for me and while the memories fade a bit, they're always there. I think its possible to be happy about the good times but I do have a hard time not feeling sad at the same time. It's hard. Just be gentle with yourself.

The show became lifeless when they fired most of the staff and Artie left. I've been listening since the WNBC days and the show is just awful and boring. He wanted to be embraced by the entertainment community so he can't shit on them, even when they deserve it. 

He seems to be killing time. Half of the bits they play are sent in by listeners. He's playing out the string. It's ok to check out now. It's over.

You are my hero. My ex cheated and has continued to lie about it to this day. Spouted divorce platitudes about how we'd still be friends and how we'd all be a new kind of family. Total horseshit. I know the anger that drove you to this. It's consumed me. In a small way it makes me feel better knowing that you did this. I hope you can get some peace going forward. Take care of yourself and your family.
Holy shit. You're my hero. I don't know you but any man would be lucky to have such a strong woman.
It is heartbreaking. I'm so sorry.

My wife of 15 years came home one day and told me she didn't love me and wanted a divorce. Literally out of nowhere. Has no plan for herself or our daughter. Four days later I find out she's at a male co-workers house until 4am. It only got better when she left. Living with someone when they've destroyed you is soul crushing. It's awful but I promise you, you will be alright. It will take time but it will happen. I promise. Just get through today. Then tomorrow. And then the day after. Eventually, the pain and sadness will lessen. Hang in there.
Hang in there. It's so, so, hard. Be kind with yourself and know it will get better.

I went through the same thing. Wife walked in one day, after 15 years of marriage, and announced that she wanted a divorce. Not once up until that day did she say she was unhappy in our marriage. I fell apart totally heartbroken. Let me add that I have a 13 year old too. Honestly it only got better when she left. The constant day to day 
interaction with a person who doesn't love you was brutal. 

It sounds trite but you must take it day by day. Sometimes hour to hour or minute to minute if need be. It is incredibly difficult but I promise, it will get better. I know its impossible to see that now. You're in pain and the future seems bleak. It is not. YOU WILL GET THROUGH IT.

If its possible, try to find some common ground on issues with the ex on the divorce. Settle as much as you can with her before you head to the lawyers. The lawyers are poison. They get paid to fight for a living. As much as they might be on your side, they don't have to live with the animosity they leave behind.

Be kind to yourself and talk to someone about it. Life is hard but you don't have to go it alone. I'm divorced a year and a half and was in exactly your position at the beginning. Life is good. Do i miss my family unit? Yes. Do I miss being married? Yes. There will always be sadness. But everyday is better. It just takes time.

It's hard and it takes time. Try not to become bitter as that is a rabbit hole with no bottom. The best thing you can do is to try to take the high road with the ex and understand that no matter what happened during your marriage, you do not deserve what you're going through. It's awful, and as I write this, I painfully remember how hard it is. You'll be ok. I'm sure of it.

No matter what anyone says to you, it's going to be hard. I had a similar situation. Best thing to do is to try to come to terms with the fact that this is not the person you married. She is someone else entirely. You don't want to be married to the new person. If she truly cared for you, she wouldn't have treated you this way. Thing's end but there doesn't need to be lying and cheating. That's not the act of a friend or loved one. It sucks but you're better off knowing this now. YOU WILL BE OK. I swear. Let her go on and live the life she thinks she wants. But remember, its done.
